value.author: Margarita
value.title: استثنائي
value.text:
The rooms are simple, not luxurious, but very clean and the beds were comfortable. The location is excellent — within walking distance of the main attractions.
The host showed genuine care — he asked about our arrival time, offered help with transfer, and told us we could stay a bit longer if needed. He also kindly treated us to cold water, which was very appreciated in the heat.
He guided us where to park the car, which was very helpful. Overall, we felt truly welcome and had everything we needed for a pleasant and comfortable stay.
